files.operations.sop:
@op.games.hangman.newGame core.operation
    impl=newGame
    semantics=action
    action=hm.new
    doc="Starts a game with a seeded pseudo-random animal word (or the word given in arg word); arg keep=true keeps a game in progress. Brings the hangman tab forward."

@op.games.hangman.letter core.operation
    impl=letter
    semantics=action
    action=hm.letter
    doc="Guesses one letter; a wrong letter costs one of the six guesses."

@op.games.hangman.word core.operation
    impl=word
    semantics=action
    action=hm.word
    doc="Guesses the whole word; a wrong guess costs one of the six guesses."

@op.games.hangman.hint core.operation
    impl=hint
    semantics=action
    action=hm.hint
    doc="A fact about the animal from the kids.animals knowledge base (no guess is lost)."

@op.games.hangman.giveUp core.operation
    impl=giveUp
    semantics=action
    action=hm.giveup
    doc="Gives up and tells the word."

@op.games.hangman.status core.operation
    impl=status
    semantics=action
    action=hm.status
    doc="Shows the masked word, the guessed letters and the guesses left."

files.schema.sop:
# Declaration only (spec 21 section 6, spec 25): games.hangman keeps its own patterns and operations. This schema serves the dice, the example chips and the action buttons (std.sample):
# the whole sentences the dice may say are read from the world's own state by the hook `sampleKnowledge` of ops.mjs (declaredExecutor). Nothing is generated except schema.declared.mjs.
@hangman acts.schema
    noun="letter"
    declare=yes
    doc="Hangman: the letters not asked yet in a game that is on."
    acts=make

@hangman.letter acts.kind
    know=letters:*
    dice.not=make
    plural=letters
